verification_report.summary: The proof is correct and complete. It proves the required Bézout identity from the well-ordering principle and division algorithm, constructs CRT idempotents that establish existence for all moduli (including the empty-product case when k=1), and proves uniqueness modulo the full product by a valid induction using pairwise coprimality. No external references, unsupported fact citations, hard-prohibition violations, critical errors, or gaps occur.
